content:
The tool requires at least one criteria parameter (functional_groups_broken, formed, bonds etc.) as list of strings. So we need to provide at least one of those. Provide functional_groups_broken maybe "alkyl halide" etc. Let's provide a simple criterion that likely matches many templates, e.g., functional_groups_broken: ["C-C double bonds"].

We'll call with molecule_smiles target and functional_groups_broken list.
